Subject: Post-demo items: SOC 2 status + SVQ kickoff

Thanks for the demo today — that was very helpful. A few items the security team asked to kick off asap so we can progress procurement:

1) SOC 2: can you confirm whether Redwood has an active SOC 2 Type II report and the coverage dates?
2) GDPR / HIPAA: we need a short note on data residency and whether you support BAA (HIPAA) for PHI.
3) Vendor security questionnaire (we attach our SVQ template) — can you identify an owner and an estimated ETA for a first-pass response?
4) Telemetry / cookies: security and privacy teams want a mapping of what your console and docs sites track (console telemetry, docs analytics, third-party cookies). A simple CSV is fine.

I've attached the SVQ template (MedAI_SVQ_Template.xlsx) to this message. Could you please confirm next steps and a target date?

Thanks,
Elena

- SVQ: We'll take your Excel and produce a first-pass completed SVQ. Owner: Laura + Security ops. ETA: first draft by Feb 17 (EOD PST).
- Telemetry / cookies: Laura will pull a CSV inventory of console and docs telemetry endpoints and third-party cookies. We'll flag any analytics cookies and how we handle opt-outs. ETA: Feb 16.

- Vivek to schedule a 30-min follow-up to review the SVQ draft and telemetry matrix (propose Feb 12).

Hi Elena — attaching the requested artifacts and a short inventory. Highlights below; full CSV attached.

- SOC 2: Confirmed (see Rishi's note). We can provide the report via secure ShareFile link once SA is in place.
- GDPR / HIPAA: Production can be pinned to AWS regions in EU and US; for HIPAA we'll start the BAA process.
- SVQ: Completed first-pass answers for the majority of questions; outstanding items flagged where legal input is required. See attachment: Redwood_SVQ_Response_DRAFT.docx
- Telemetry / cookies: attached telemetry_matrix.csv — columns: endpoint, telemetry_type (usage/metrics/analytics), pii_flag (yes/no), storage_location, third_party_libs, cookie_name. Key notes:
  * Console: basic usage metrics (route, errors, request latency). No PHI is collected as part of request telemetry; we only log request metadata.
  * Docs site: uses Google Analytics (ga_cookie) for page views and lighthouse; no user-level PHI.
  * Third-party cookies: analytics.google.com, sentry.io (error aggregation, anonymized).

Attachments: telemetry_matrix.csv, Redwood_SVQ_Response_DRAFT.docx

- Elena: if you can provide the preferred format for the BAA or procurement contact, Laura will expedite legal review.
